purpose: Documents assumptions made while building the Luxor Guest House deployable MVP so they can be reviewed and replaced with confirmed data before go-live.
assumptions: The email address info@luxorguesthouse.local is a placeholder and uses a non-routable .local TLD. Replace it with a real, deliverable mailbox before production.
Room reference prices are quoted in GBP 'plus taxes' as supplied and are treated as per-night reference rates, not final quotes.
Tour prices are quoted in USD and treated as per person unless the source noted otherwise (e.g. Aswan Philae trip noted 'one person').
Tours marked 'price on request' are stored with price = null and a price_on_request flag; the UI shows 'Price on request'.
Check-in (from 14:00) and check-out (until 11:00) times are reasonable defaults and were not supplied; confirm with the property.
The cancellation policy text is inferred from the 'no prepayment / no credit card' trust signals and should be verified.
The booking enquiry flow records leads only; it does not take payment or guarantee availability. Availability and final pricing are confirmed by the property via WhatsApp.
The concierge is a deterministic, keyword-based assistant over the local ledger data (rooms, tours, policies, FAQ, contacts). It does not call any external LLM.
Booking.com rating (9.0) and review count (470) are point-in-time values supplied by the operator and may change.
